    • getLiquidFirstMomentAboutCentre

      public double getLiquidFirstMomentAboutCentre()
      Get the liquid first area moment about the pipe centre in the normal-depth direction.

      The minority segment is evaluated first so neither a thin film nor a thin gas cap subtracts two full-section moments. The complementary moment is its exact negative.

      Returns:
      nonpositive integral of normal height minus half diameter over liquid area, in m3

    • getGasFirstMomentAboutCentre

      public double getGasFirstMomentAboutCentre()
      Get the gas first area moment about the pipe centre in the normal-depth direction.
      Returns:
      nonnegative integral of normal height minus half diameter over gas area, in m3

    • getGravityPotentialEnergyPerLength

      public double getGravityPotentialEnergyPerLength(double gasDensity, double liquidDensity, double normalGravity)
      Calculate normal-gravity potential energy relative to the pipe centre per unit axial length.

      Supply normal gravity as g times cosine of inclination. This read-only energy budget excludes centreline elevation, internal/kinetic energy and wall energy; it does not modify a solver state. No new serialized fields are needed. An absent phase's density is unused.

      Parameters:
      gasDensity - positive gas density in kg/m3 when gas is present
      liquidDensity - positive liquid density in kg/m3 when liquid is present
      normalGravity - finite signed normal component of gravity in m/s2
      Returns:
      cross-sectional gravitational energy relative to the centre, in J/m
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if present-phase density or gravity is invalid, or energy overflows
